column1: # The types column measured at CATEGORY grain - OPUS, 2026-09-21.
# WHY CATEGORY AND NOT SYSTEM, which is what a reader will want. There is no system-to-type
# mapping in this store: a type carries a category, a system carries a category, and 16 of the 23
# categories are shared by two to six systems. Only 7 systems own their category alone. A first
# version of this file reported one row per system and was withdrawn before publication: six
# systems would have shown identical numbers as though each had been measured on its own.
# TEN TYPES HAVE NO PARSEABLE NUMERIC SIZE (PSharray, Widget, FieldRecordTable,
# EquipmentDefinitionRecord, NavRunStateBlock, ActorRecordPool and four more). Their rows would
# count toward a numerator while contributing nothing to a denominator, so they are excluded from
# covered_pct and counted in unsized_types instead.
# AND COVERAGE IS DISTINCT BYTES, NOT THE SUM OF ROW LENGTHS - which is what actually produced the
# 107.7% an earlier draft showed for category 08. Rows legitimately OVERLAP where a packed field is
# also byte-addressed: ImageAddressArenaRecord declares a dword at +0x04 whose second byte is read
# separately at +0x05. Two types carry real overlap - BattleStatsRecord, 508 row-bytes over a
# 456-byte extent, and EncodedIdQueryRecord, 154 over 152 - and in BOTH the highest row END equals
# the declared size exactly, so nothing overflows its type. The excess was double counting, not a
# data defect, and the fix is the metric rather than the rows.
# covered_pct   bytes inside declared field rows over declared size, over SIZED types only.
#               100% does NOT mean resolved - it means no byte sits outside a row.
# resolved_pct  bytes in rows at TYPE RESOLVED or SEMANTICALLY IDENTIFIED. CLASSIFIED is NOT
#               counted: it is a real rung the store uses heavily and folding it in would flatter
#               the figure. Read the two columns together.
# gap_rows      rows still DISCOVERED - usually what a types cell actually turns on.
# types_below   declared types in the category not at TYPE RESOLVED.
# 33 of the 44 non-MET types cells have no stated reason anywhere; 27 of those systems have no
# verdict section at all. Three measured by hand this session (S-17, S-21, S-33) all came out the
# same shape - coverage complete, the cell turning on unresolved rows and on the type-level rung.
category
